Successfully demonstrated ability to prospect, engage, discover and secure new business. Utilizes deep industry and strong/functional knowledge of all supporting components of the data center environment to thoroughly understand customer needs and deliver the applicable sales solutions. Proven ability to engage and develop strong customer relationships in improving efficiencies, productivity, controlling capital expenditures and uptime for their custom I.T. environments translating into consistent top line revenue growth.
